Barbell_Squat: A person holding a barbell across their upper back does a slow full squat and stands back up, keeping the feet in place.
Barbell_Bench_Press_-_Medium_Grip: A person lying on their back on a flat bench presses a barbell from their chest straight up until the arms are straight, then lowers it.
Barbell_Curl: A person standing still holds a barbell with both hands at the thighs and curls it up to the shoulders by bending only the elbows, then lowers it.
Pullups: A person hanging from an overhead bar with both hands pulls their body up until the chin is above the bar, then lowers down slowly.
Barbell_Shrug: A person standing still holding a barbell with straight arms at the thighs shrugs their shoulders up towards the ears and lowers them.
Standing_Calf_Raises: A person standing in place rises up onto their toes, lifting the heels high, then slowly lowers the heels back down.
Leg_Extensions: A person sitting on a machine seat straightens both knees, lifting the lower legs forward until the legs are straight, then lowers them.
Pushups: A person in a push-up position on the floor lowers their chest to the ground by bending the elbows and pushes back up, body straight.
Dumbbell_Lunges: A person holding dumbbells at their sides steps forward into a lunge, lowering the back knee towards the floor, then steps back to standing.
Plank: A person holds a plank on their forearms and toes with a straight body, staying still.
